integrity: The finite-budget floors, inverse score requirements, and Jacobian magnitudes are derived directly from the source box maps. Gaussian asymptotics use the standard Mills ratio; a standalone checker replays finite-scale identities and representative asymptotic ordering.
scientific_limitations: The classification is exact for the separable box policies with identity latent matrix. It does not claim the same rates for arbitrary nonseparable polytopes or an end-to-end training-time ordering.
title: Three exact boundary-complexity classes for box Legendre-regularized policies
